[quote=orange_creek;60934595][b][u]STARBOUND RP[/u]

[Spoiler=The Devil Wears Ceramic]

Operation Scoria II[/b]

Blood, ash, mangled metal on a flat ground, like disjointed iconography of an absurdist art piece. 

It was just like Aceldama. Just a few minutes after landing, and the area around NSI3-5's mobile suit was now a land of utter destruction. However, thanks to lessons learned from NSI3-4's overly ambitious approach, NSI3-5 moved cautiously, hiding its mobile suit in the rubble of its own making like makeshift sandbags to coneal and protect itself from the gradually overwhelming Illynite reponse.

The Wardens' 25mm kinetic penetrators would be insufficient to harm Frame 167, whose heavy composite armor would easily absorb, if not outright shatter the darts on contact. That was, if they could hit at all, with NSI3-5 having been wise to keep its ballistic shield on its rear, where the Wardens' projectile fire would be met and checked by a gigantic wall of 30mm silicon carbide ceramic backed by 100mm of ballistic steel.

[LIST]"So Illynites have been mass producing mechtech too..." NSI3-5 said, furrowing her eyebrows as barrage after barrage of depleted uranium penetrators crashed against the thick shield of the Frame 167, each bursting impact causing the clone to jump from shock. "... ineffective in the mean time though, I should be g-..."[/LIST]

Just then, NSI3-5's words are cut off by a sudden, destructive blast that staggers the mobile suit, causing it to almost tumble down to the ground, though MSI3-5 saves itself, grabbing onto a shattered dome to slow its fall. A well-aimed tank shell had hit Frame 167's lower torso, causing some of its mobility thrusters and fuel cells to detonate in a fiery blast. Clicking her tongue, MSI3-5 quickly grabbed hold of her mobile suit's shield and placed it in front of her to keeping the mobile suit's cockpit and torso safe from further damage.

[LIST]"This is getting hectic... almost out of ammo at least, this should be good enough..." muttered the clone, micromanaging not just the actual battle itself, but also whether it had appropriate used all types of missiles and penetrators, whether it had maximized the mobility and propulsion systems of her mobile suit, even basic functions such as accessing the UI and signalling systems under combat to stress test the machine as much as she feasibly could. "Looks like this is it then... urk...!"[/LIST]

Another explosion, this time hitting clean against the shield, causing huge chunks of razor sharp fragments to rain down onto the ground below. An [i]Artillerist[/i], concealed among the multitude of responding military units, had opened fire with a gigantic shell that would blast part of Frame 167's shield into nothingness, exposing its steel backing and badly damaging the mobile suit's left arm, the shield tilting at an awkward angle now, exposing part of the mobile suit's upper chest.

Wary that its time was now running short, MSI3-5 quickly walked back and away from the Illynite onslaught, continuing to open fire with its railgun on the Wardens and tanks, while its rockets would prioritize fighting against the PT boats still hovering in the sky, though only seconds later, both of 167's shoulder-mounted rocket launchers would detonate, self-destructing after running out of ammunition to prevent identification. [/spoiler][/quote]

[list][list] [ STARBOUND ] -| [b] The Ilynite Sovereignty [/b] - [i] The Frozen Paradise "[/i] |- [/list][/list]
[list][list][pre]| Ilynis-1A, Ruined Sanctuary - M2LN |[/pre][/list][/list]

[Spoiler= Unknown Combatant Contact / Codename: "Devil" ]
[b] Ilynis-1A Surface [/b]

[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[List] | Many of the Tanks and Wardens in particular were often than not covering each other, yet like all things they couldn't sustain a hit from a railgun, even as "Devil" (Frame 167) went about knocking each and everyone of them like pins It still took a fair amount of time especially for the more tricky and maneuverable targets and crews which caught on, some using their low profile to try to maneuver and distract all the while still managing to gets shots on target, if anything else the crews were accurate however the bumpy surface made things a bit tricky especially if they caught air for a few moments. |

| To which a few of them managed to either by intention or by happenstance. |

| By the time of Launching Missiles the Wardens those that were left automatically reprioritized to Airborne targets, unlike attacking "Devil" they were much more accurate with their shots only a couple made it past their scans although by the time only one singular warden was left for a moment still defiantly following it's commands as it kept firing until it was finally knocked out, unfortunately for "Devil" the PT Boats managed to burn hard enough to get into range of their 120mm Guns while using their onboard PDF Weapons to deal with the inbound rockets. | 

| And almost like clockwork combined with the few remaining artillerists and the small pair of tanks which managed to circle around like skittering rodents looking for an opportunity for a meal | 

| A Few Rockets managed to hit their mark on a PT Boat, setting it alight and splitting the ship in two as it managed to fire off a final defiant salvo, the other one rushed forward continuing the salvo from it's fallen compatriot, it's bombardment kicking up dust and debris within a wide radius as it continued to maneuver about, not staying still within a singular location and providing enough cover for the slowly approaching reinforcements, another grouping of tanks combined with Artillerists from a nearby intact residential dome | [/list][/Spoiler]

[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[List] | As the Bombardment continued and as a second collection of roughly 20 Tanks mixed with an additional 9 Artillerists started to approach and open fire, upon the Combatant a singular radio transmission was directed towards "Devil" a stern voice on the other line, seeming to address it as the tide was rapidly turning in favor for the Ilynites | [/list]

[list][list][i][pre]" Unknown Assailant, your actions upon the Ilynite Sovereignty will be remembered as a deliberate war crime we are offering you the chance for the preservation of your life, Seize your hostilities and debark your Combat Unit, or be turned into stardust like the feral beast you are "[/pre][/i][/list][/list]

"A compilation of reports courtesy of International Policy. ISCOS is defying the Federation on the Dupont issue."

"I don't need this right now" Euphrasia says, sighing as she turned the page of the file folder. "We're currently sitting on a powder keg that's just waiting for a tinderbox called Korrin to blow everything up. Who cares if a competitor is taking what isn't theirs?"

"The Federation deems it a great threat, Ms. El Howayek." the staffer says calmly.

"What does SummitONE think?"

"They think ISCOS is being hampered from conducting its business."

"Of course they do... man... am I really being called into this?..." Euphrasia scrunched up her face, clearly annoyed by this rapidly devolving series of events. A rebellion, reports of massacres in deep space, and now a disobedient Erenite megacorporation taking over Federation territory. For a moment, El Howayek pondered whether the Federation truly was worth saving after all. But she held the thought in private. "Agh, this is ridiculous... someone get someone to contact Governor Daza, I'll see what I can do in the mean time! Just don't bother me right now any more, if there's something urgent, get Euphemia to sort things out, she's always on her ass anyways."

"Very well, Ms. El Howayek. Shall I inform Mr. FitzDavid of what's been discussed right now?"

"God no. He'll try and delay things until this becomes a [i]fait accompli[/i]. The last thing we need right now is more distractions. Now go, shoo, shoo. I'll be busy trying to save this piece of crap Federation from falling apart..."

[b]Operation Crusader[/b]

The League of the Orange Creek was now in crisis mode. SummitONE, the [i]de facto[/i] monopoly on much of the nation's military assets, was currently busy "with highly academic matters" and was unwilling to send any assets to protect the Federation from her enemies. Thus, the fate of Erene rested, in part, on the El Howayek Group (EHG), a predominantly civilian conglomerate under the control of the El Howayek Sisters. Though well-regarded for their inventory of spacecraft designs, EHG was behind on most emerging military tech, namely concerning the use of mobile suits.

Still though, as the League's most pro-Federation corporate body, the EHG had to do something if it means preserving the fragile political order that had helped sustain the League for decades up to this point. Not that Euphrasia El Howayek, EHG CEO, would be particularly enthusiastic about this newfound duty.

After a brief session with Emperor Candor II Daza, the incumbent Vespurian Emperor and Governor of the League, EHG would be authorized to execute a punitive expedition on behalf of the Federation to punish what it deems "to be the harbingers of violence and disorder", organizing a fleet of 6 Andiron-class gunboats and 2 Speedwell-class escort frigates to attempt and dismantle the ISCOS Dupont colony. Supreme command over the operation would be given to Daza himself, a distinguished veteran of the recent Marisalbic War.

However, despite the heavy firepower being spent by the League for this expedition, in reality, the EHG would not be willing to initiate as the aggressor.

An hour before Operation Crusader was due to begin, the EHG would send a civilian shuttle to the ISCOS Dupont project, firing infrared communication lasers at its satellites to initiate contact. In a brief set of demands, the EHG would ask ISCOS to negotiate the dismantlement of its colonial project in return for several assurances which the EHG and the wider League hopes to uphold with the Federation High Council. These points would be summarized as follows:

[list]1. ISCOS is to cancel the development of its ISCOS colony and return to Erene within the earliest possible time frame.

2. ISCOS is to exhaust all policy mechanisms to peacefully reintegrate under the Erene Federation's constitutional framework.

And in exchange,

3. The League promises a waiting period of 1 year, during which it shall attempt to lobby the adoption of a legal remedy to enable ISCOS to legally settle Dupont and achieve its territorial ambitions.

4. The League promises to come to ISCOS's aid in any future war against an enemy that seeks to undermine its geopolitical interests.[/list]

If the above measures are not honored, or if ISCOS is unwilling to discuss a revision of the terms within a 1 week grace period, Emperor Candor II shall be formally empowered as an officer of the Federation to begin its punitive expedition to remove ISCOS by an awesome feat of force and arms.[/quote]
